description: Use this to replace (or with merge=true, add to) the files of a slug you already own. Requires the token from the first publish. There is no restore-version call; send the previous files again to undo. Returns the same shape as publish_site with a bumped version.

files.description:
Map of relative path to file contents. Paths are stored exactly as given (a single top-level directory is not removed). Text as a string, binary as {"base64":"..."}. Example: {"index.html":"

Hi

","img/logo.png":{"base64":"iVBOR..."}}

merge.description: Keep every path you do not send, and add or overwrite only these exact paths.

slug.description: Slug you own. Must match ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$. Not rewritten. Reserved slugs are rejected.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: update_site
title: Update a site
